map.基于 Prentice 法则 P = c × F，计算棱镜移心量或光学中心偏移诱: Based on Prentice's rule P = c x F, computing the prism induced by decentration or by an optical centre offset
map.普伦蒂斯法则：棱镜度 P = 移心量(cm) × |度数 F|；移心量 c =: Prentice's rule: prism dioptres P = decentration (cm) x |dioptres F|; decentration c = P / |F|
map.镜片光学中心偏离视线 c(cm) 即产生 P=c·|F| 棱镜度；正镜向基底方向: An optical centre offset c(cm) from the line of sight produces P = c x |F| prism dioptres; positive lenses decentrate toward the base and negative lenses in the opposite direction of the base.
map.由移心量与该处屈光度算棱镜度。: Compute the prism dioptres from the decentration and the dioptres at that point.
map.隐形棱镜效应补偿隐斜。: Compensate heterophoria with the prismatic effect.
map.装配移心是否超容差。: Check whether the assembly prism exceeds tolerance.
map.：光度 −5.00D、光学中心偏移 1cm → 棱镜 P=c×F=1×5=5Δ（: With a power of -5.00D and an optical centre offset of 1cm -> prism P = c x F = 1 x 5 = 5 delta, base toward the offset; used to compensate exophoria.
map.：装配棱镜允差通常 ±0.5Δ，移心 1cm 在 −5D 下产生 5Δ，超单眼: The assembly prism tolerance is usually +/-0.5 delta; a 1cm decentration at -5D produces 5 delta, and exceeding 2 delta in one eye is uncomfortable, so precision matters or a prism segment is needed.
map.普伦蒂斯法则：棱镜度=移心量(cm)×该点屈光度(D)，底向由移心方向定。: Prentice's rule: prism dioptres = decentration (cm) x the dioptres at that point (D); the base direction follows the direction of decentration.
map.何时用棱镜片而非移心？: When Should You Use a Prism Segment Instead of Decentration?
map.需求棱镜大（>2Δ）或高度数移心致厚薄不均时，直接磨棱镜片更准。: When the required prism is large (>2 delta) or a high-power lens makes centre thickness uneven, grinding prism lenses directly is more accurate.
